STAGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO: Here you can browse all public trials available: dates, location and organizer.
STAGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO_2: By default, trials from 1 month back up to 2 months ahead are shown.
STAGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO_3: You can display trials in three ways: as a list, as a table or on a map. Switch between them with the selector at the top.
STAGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO_4: Each card shows the trial and its competition, with 1 the date and 2 the location.
STAGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO_5: Below, each event with 3 its details (rank, discipline, name, competitors and awards), 4 the event actions and 5 the info button with the trial's full details.
STAGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO_6: Tap + to expand the filters panel and ✕ to collapse it. You can filter by name, country, status and dates.
STAGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO_7: On the map, each dot's color shows the trial status: blue created, amber about to start, green in progress and dark grey finished. Live trials (about to start or in progress) pulse.
STAGES.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO: Here you can check this trial's details and, if applicable, enroll your dogs.
STAGES.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_2: The screen has two tabs: Events, with the trial's events, and Notifications, with the organizer's announcements.
STAGES.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_3: Each event shows 1 its details (name, discipline, configuration and rank), 2 the user actions — enrollment or classification — and 3 the enrolled-competitors panel.
STAGES.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_4: When expanded you'll see each enrolled competitor: 4 the country, 5 the dog with its breed and 6 the handler with their club or team.
STAGES.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_5: When you enroll, and until the organizer accepts the enrollment, the competitor shows like this, pending verification.
STAGES.EVENT_DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO: Here you can check this event's classification in real time.
STAGES.EVENT_DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_2: The classification adapts to your screen size: when you see this icon, rotate your device; in landscape, the table view shows all the scores at a glance.
STAGES.EVENT_DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_3: You can view the classification as a list or as a table; switch between them with the selector at the top.
STAGES.EVENT_DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_4: Above the classification you have 1 the last-updated time and 2 the trial info, which expands with +.
STAGES.EVENT_DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_5: When expanded you'll see 3 the event's general info (qualification, rank, discipline, configuration, score calculation and judges) and 4 the competitor filter.
STAGES.EVENT_DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_6: Each card shows 5 the position, 6 the dog and handler info along with the competitor number, 7 the pin, which keeps the card at the top so you don't lose track of the competitor, 8 the scores per exercise with the total and 9 the expandable detail.
STAGES.EVENT_DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_7: In the detail you'll see 10 each exercise, 11 each judge's mark (by their initials) and 12 the exercise score out of its maximum.
STAGES.EVENT_DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_8: Icons you may see: under Awards, 13 the dog's position and 14 the discipline awards; under Dog, 15 reserve, 16 bitch in heat and 17 disqualification; under Score, 18 a red card and 19 a yellow card.

MY.DOGS.BREADCRUMB_INFO: Here you can register and manage the dogs under your name so you can enroll them in trials.
MY.DOGS.BREADCRUMB_INFO_2: Use the search field to filter your dogs by name.
MY.DOGS.BREADCRUMB_INFO_3: You can view your dogs as a list or as a table; switch between them with the selector at the bottom.
MY.DOGS.BREADCRUMB_INFO_4: Use the + button in the bottom-right corner to register a new dog.
MY.DOGS.BREADCRUMB_INFO_5: Each dog card shows 1 its name, 2 the sex and breed, 3 the identifier, and the actions to 4 delete or 5 edit it.
MY.DOGS.BREADCRUMB_INFO_6: When creating or editing a dog, 6 indicates whether it has 3 generations recognized by the FCI. If you are an organizer you'll also see 7 the ownership checkbox, which determines whether the dog belongs to a k9x user (their account email).
MY.JUDGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO: Here you can register and manage the judges who collaborate with you in your competitions.
MY.JUDGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO_2: Use the search field to filter your judges by name.
MY.JUDGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO_3: You can view your judges as a list or as a table; switch between them with the selector at the bottom.
MY.JUDGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO_4: Use the + button in the bottom-right corner to register a new judge.
MY.JUDGES.BREADCRUMB_INFO_5: Each judge card shows 1 their country and name, and the actions to 2 delete or 3 edit them.
MY.COLLECTIONS.BREADCRUMB_INFO: Here you'll find the trials where you take part as a judge, to enter scores.
MY.COLLECTIONS.BREADCRUMB_INFO_2: Each collection shows 1 its status, 2 the discipline and event, 3 the competition, 4 the trial and 5 the button to start scoring.
MY.COLLECTIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO: Here you can enter and review the participants' scores for this trial.
MY.COLLECTIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_2: At the top you have 1 the trial info, 2 the competitor selector and 3 the card buttons. Below, 4 the judge and 5 the box to enter each exercise's score.
MY.COLLECTIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_3: With these buttons you register a yellow or red card for the competitor.
MY.COLLECTIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_4: Tapping them opens this dialog: pick 6 the judge and 7 the exercise, then register it.
MY.COMPETITIONS.BREADCRUMB_INFO: Here you can create and manage the competitions you organize, along with their stages and events.
MY.COMPETITIONS.BREADCRUMB_INFO_2: Each card shows 1 the competition's details (name, country, status, location and organization), 2 its stages with their dates and 3 the info button to open the detail.
MY.COMPETITIONS.BREADCRUMB_INFO_3: You can view your competitions as a list or as a table; switch between them with the selector at the bottom.
MY.COMPETITIONS.BREADCRUMB_INFO_4: The competition status is shown with a color: Draft if it was created with a poor or no connection and is pending sync, Created while it's still editable, Started and Finished.
MY.COMPETITIONS.BREADCRUMB_INFO_5: Use the + button in the bottom-right corner to create a new competition.
MY.COMPETITIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO: Here you can manage this competition's details and its stages.
MY.COMPETITIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_2: At the top you have 1 the competition's details (status, name, description and address). Below, 2 its stages with their basic info (status, dates and number of events) and 3 the info button to open the stage detail.
MY.COMPETITIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_3: The stage status is shown with a color: Draft if it was created with a poor or no connection and is pending sync, Created while it's still editable, To start, Started and Finished.
MY.COMPETITIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_4: You can view the stages as a list or as a table; switch between them with the selector at the bottom.
MY.COMPETITIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_5: The gear button turns on edit mode, which enables actions on the competition.
MY.COMPETITIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_6: When enabled, you'll see the pencil, to edit the details, and the gear, which unfolds the remaining actions.
MY.COMPETITIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_7: With the gear unfolded you can delete the competition, add a stage, undo the changes or collapse the menu again.
MY.COMPETITIONS.DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_INFO_8: In edit mode, each stage also shows its own actions to delete or edit it.
MY.COMPETITIONS.STAGE_DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_: Here you can manage the events included in this stage.
At the top you have 1 the stage's details (status and dates). Below, 2 its events with their basic info (name, status, rank and discipline) and 3 the info button to open the event detail.
You can view the events as a list or as a table; switch between them with the selector at the bottom.
The gear button turns on edit mode, which enables actions on the stage.
When enabled, you'll see the pencil, to edit the details, and the gear, which unfolds the remaining actions.
With the gear unfolded you can delete the stage, add an event, undo the changes or collapse the menu again.
In edit mode, each event also shows its own actions to delete or edit it.
MY.COMPETITIONS.EVENT_DETAIL.BREADCRUMB_: Here you can configure this event: judges, exercises and competitors.

Above the tabs you have the event's general data: 1 the status, 2 the discipline, 3 the grade and federation, 4 the enrollment deadline, 5 the score calculation and 6 the awards. You must add a grade to enable the tabs.
The event status is shown with a color: Draft if it was created with a poor or no connection and is pending sync, Created, Enrollment closed, Started and Finished.
Each tab includes this selector to switch between list and table view.
The Judges tab lists the event's judges: 7 the judge and 8 their collector — an existing k9x user (their email) who will collect the scores.
The Exercises tab shows 9 each exercise's name, 10 its tags (if any) and 11 the judges it applies to — useful for multiple rings.

The Competitors tab has 12 the Accept pending checkbox, which filters pending enrollments (they show a button to accept them), 13 the competition dog's data (sex, indicators, dog, identity and team) and 14 the Scores button to review its scores.
The gear button turns on edit mode, which enables actions on the event.
When enabled, you'll see the pencil, to edit the details, and the gear, which unfolds the remaining actions.
With the gear unfolded you can delete the event, undo the changes, collapse the menu and add an item for the active tab: a judge, an exercise or a competitor.

HOME.HERO_LEAD: K9X is a self-managed platform for canine sport. Find events, follow scores live, enroll your dogs as a competitor, and create and run competitions as an organizer.
HOME.WHAT_IS_DESCRIPTION_1: K9X gathers canine sport events in one place: trials, schedules, entries, exercises, judges, and results. Everything is published and kept up to date by the community itself — organizers run their competitions and competitors manage their own dogs and entries.
HOME.WHAT_IS_DESCRIPTION_2: Anyone can browse events and results without an account. Sign in to enroll in trials, follow your dogs, or request organizer access and run competitions end to end — even from the field, with or without network.
HOME.CARD_BROWSE_DESCRIPTION: Find upcoming and past trials, check dates, venues, and judges, and review full results — no account needed.
HOME.CARD_LIVE_DESCRIPTION: Watch live classifications during competition days: exercise scores and standings update as judges record them.
HOME.CARD_ENROLL_DESCRIPTION: Sign in, pick a trial, and enter your dogs in a few taps. Your entries and results stay linked to your profile.
HOME.CARD_ORGANIZE_DESCRIPTION: As an organizer, set up competitions, trials, and events, assign judges, and record scores through the whole competition day.
HOME.CARD_DOGS_DESCRIPTION: Keep your dogs' details in one place and reuse them for every entry, with their competition history alongside.
HOME.CARD_ACCOUNT_DESCRIPTION: Signing in unlocks the full experience: offline use, advanced filters, and language and theme preferences.
HOME.CARD_OFFLINE_DESCRIPTION: K9X is local-first: scoring and field work keep going without network and sync when you are back online.
HOME.FAQ_WHAT_A: K9X is a self-managed platform for canine sport competitions. Organizers publish and run competitions, competitors enroll their dogs and follow results, and anyone can browse events and live scores.
HOME.FAQ_ENROLL_Q: How do I enroll in a trial?
HOME.FAQ_ENROLL_A: Sign in with your Google account, add your dogs to your profile, then open the trial you want and enroll. Your entries appear in the trial and your results build up under your dogs.
HOME.FAQ_ORGANIZER_Q: How do I become an organizer?
HOME.FAQ_ORGANIZER_A: Sign in and use the "Want to be organizer?" option in the menu to send an organizer request. Once approved, you can create competitions, trials, and events, and manage judges and scoring.
HOME.FAQ_OFFLINE_A: Yes. K9X is built local-first: you can keep browsing loaded data and recording scores without network, and your changes sync automatically when you reconnect.
HOME.FAQ_ACCOUNT_Q: What do I get by signing in?
HOME.FAQ_ACCOUNT_A: Signed-in users unlock extra functionality: offline use with automatic sync, advanced filters, and personal preferences such as language and theme. Competitors can also enroll their dogs, and organizers can run their competitions.
